items.hook: Of Stars and Men is a 1964 American animated documentary film directed by John Hubley, based on the 1959 book of the same title by astronomer Harlow Shapley, who also narrates.

items.hook: The Munda languages, spoken mainly in eastern and central India, are part of the Austroasiatic family, which also includes Khmer and Vietnamese spoken in Southeast Asia.
items.body: However, Munda languages as well as their reconstructed ancestral predecessor proto-Munda show significant differences from their Southeast Asian relatives, especially in phonology, morphology, and lexical inventories, likely due to prolonged language contact
